summary: User was recruited as an intermediary to find a BTC seller for a purported transaction involving thousands of BTC and hundreds of millions of dollars with commissions while the proposed procedure required the seller to send a Satoshi and accept insurance penalties
user_mistake: agreed to seek a seller for an unverified high value OTC transaction
prevention: Verify the buyer and counterparties through independent legal and institutional channels before introducing a seller / Refuse any procedure requiring upfront insurance or penalty payments
